addresses.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `addresses` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `identity_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `document_number` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `type` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'Casa',
  `primary` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `secondary` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `references` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `latitud` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `longitud` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `url_maps` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reception_hours` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `sunday_hours` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT 'Address::INACTIVE = 0, Address::ACTIVE = 1',
  `is_default` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `district_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `sort_order` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `addressable_type` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `addressable_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `addresses_identity_id_foreign` (`identity_id`),
  KEY `addresses_district_id_foreign` (`district_id`),
  KEY `addresses_addressable_type_addressable_id_index` (`addressable_type`,`addressable_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `addresses_district_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`district_id`) REFERENCES `districts` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `addresses_identity_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`identity_id`) REFERENCES `identities` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
